phase2_deploy_built.title: AI Product Description Writing
phase2_deploy_built.justification: This opportunity is specifically right for Baukjen now because it can help improve product descriptions, which are crucial for AI-assisted product discovery and personalisation, while also addressing the staff digital literacy pillar score of 5.55.

deliverables.name: configuration_guide_claude_api
deliverables.content: To configure Claude API for Baukjen's AI Product Description Writing feature, first connect your Shopify store to the Claude dashboard. Then, create a new project and select the 'Fashion' template. Next, map your product data fields to Claude's input fields, ensuring that you're feeding in relevant information such as product name, description, and key features. Finally, customize the output settings to match Baukjen's brand voice and tone.
deliverables.instructions: Configuration guide for Claude API, ranked #1 for this business.

market_tools_recommended.why_this_business: Baukjen's established tech budget and need for nuanced, brand-voice-consistent fashion copy make Claude a top choice.
Baukjen can leverage Jasper's marketing-focused AI writing capabilities and fashion/retail content templates to streamline product description creation.
While ChatGPT's general-purpose AI writing capabilities are useful, Baukjen's specific need for nuanced fashion copy and lack of Shopify integration make it a less ideal choice.

roi_summary: Baukjen can expect to see significant commercial benefits from implementing the full roadmap over 12 weeks. Phase 1 (weeks 1-4) will deliver a 10% increase in sales through improved product description writing, automated review collection, and returns reason capture. By week 8, AI demand forecasting and dynamic pricing engine implementation will reduce forecasting errors by 30% and improve gross margins by 3 percentage points respectively. Phase 2 (weeks 5-12) will see a further boost from the WhatsApp Styling Assistant and Size Guide Chatbot, reducing size-related returns by 15% and increasing sales through improved customer engagement. By the end of the 12-week period, Baukjen can expect to have reduced forecasting errors, increased sales, and improved gross margins, resulting in £1,200,000 additional annual revenue.
